meals.notes: Alcohol is never reimbursable. Client meals need the guest list on the report.

lodging.notes: Itemised hotel folio required. Anything above the nightly cap goes to the manager.

airfare.limit: USD 800 per round trip without pre-approval
airfare.notes: Economy only. Fares above the limit need written pre-approval from the department head.

ground_transport.notes: Taxi, rideshare, train. Rental cars need pre-approval.

software.notes: Software subscriptions go through procurement, never through expenses. Reject and point to procurement.
